snippet.title: I'm Making My Own Elden Skyrim
snippet.description:
➤ Get the game on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2464530/VOIN/

➤ Join the awesome community on Discord!
https://discord.gg/qtWZpPW7

➤ Twitter / X
https://twitter.com/vointhegame

In VOIN you will fight hordes of enemies in fast-paced first-person hack-and-slash battles. Explore the world of dark fantasy filled with secrets and dangers, and master your skill of wielding primordial elements.

I hope you enjoy this devlog, and if you have any questions or feedback, please let me know in the comments! Thanks for watching!

#devlog #indiegame #indiedev #gamedevelopment
